Market order ya Limit order? ⚖️

Market order kehta hai: abhi chahiye, bhaav jo bhi ho. Limit order kehta hai: mere bhaav pe, warna nahi. Ek me sauda pakka, bhaav nahi. Dusre me bhaav pakka, sauda nahi.
